profile.introZh: 自动化专业本科生，关注机器人与自主系统。通过视觉感知、运动控制、嵌入式开发与具身策略实验，把算法连接到可交互、可验证的系统。
profile.introEn: I am an undergraduate student in Automation interested in robotics and autonomous systems. My work connects visual perception, motion control, embedded development and embodied policy experiments to interactive, verifiable systems.

zh.title: 视觉与多模态交互四轴机械臂
zh.summary: 让桌面机械臂识别物品、响应指令，并通过人的反馈完成拟猫式试探与纠错。
zh.role: 团队成员 · 视觉感知、多模态交互与系统集成
contributions: 训练并部署三类桌面物品的 YOLOv8 检测模型，组织图像采集与目标定位流程。
使用 OpenCV 完成相机内参标定、畸变校正和工作平面单应映射。
集成 Vosk 中文语音、键盘输入和 MediaPipe 手部检测，组织随机试探、反馈纠错与奖励动作。
将检测、坐标转换和交互决策对接团队的机械臂执行接口，串联抓取与放置。
results: 历史训练 CSV 的最佳验证 mAP@0.5 为 86.21%，衡量目标检测表现。
历史相机标定重投影 RMS 为 0.704 px；8 点单应拟合 RMS 为 7.145 mm。
实体项目已完成并上交；公开归档保留应用源码、标定文件与训练记录。
scope: 团队完成整机；本人贡献集中于视觉、交互和集成，不认领全部机构、电路与底层驱动。
检测与标定指标不等于抓取成功率，尚无固定协议的实物重复性评测。
归档期只做离线主机检查，未重新训练、推理或驱动实物；权重、数据及厂商 DLL 未随包提供。

en.title: Vision and Multimodal Four-Axis Robot
en.summary: A desktop robot that recognizes objects, responds to commands and uses human feedback for cat-like trial and correction.
en.role: Team member · Visual perception, multimodal interaction and system integration
contributions: Trained and deployed a YOLOv8 detector for three tabletop object classes and organized image capture and target localization.
Used OpenCV for camera calibration, distortion correction and homography mapping to the work plane.
Integrated Vosk Chinese speech, keyboard input and MediaPipe hand detection into trial, correction and reward interactions.
Connected perception, coordinate conversion and interaction decisions to the team's robot execution interface for picking and placement.
results: The historical training CSV records a best validation mAP@0.5 of 86.21%, a detection metric.
Stored camera reprojection RMS is 0.704 px; the eight-point homography fit has an RMS residual of 7.145 mm.
The physical project was completed and handed in; the public archive retains application code, calibration files and training records.
scope: The robot was built as a team project. My work covers perception, interaction and integration, rather than sole ownership of mechanics, electronics and drivers.
Detection and calibration metrics are not grasp success rates; no fixed-protocol physical repeatability study is available.
Archive checks were offline only, with no new training, inference or robot motion. Weights, datasets and vendor DLLs are excluded.

zh.title: ESP32-P4/C5 多模态 WebRTC 门铃
zh.summary: 将嵌入式音视频、雷达与视觉存在感知连接到浏览器通话和舵机模拟开门。
zh.role: 独立开发 · 基于 Espressif 例程的板级适配与系统集成
contributions: 在 WT99P4C5-S1 上适配 OV5647 视频、ES8311 双向音频与 ESP32-C5 无线链路。
接入 LD2450 雷达与视觉存在检测，组织区域判断、事件去抖和重复来电抑制。
集成 PWM 舵机动作队列、保持与复位，以及中文网页和通话交互。
调整局域网连接等待与媒体资源释放流程，整理实机日志和亚克力结构加工资料。
results: 历史日志记录三轮局域网接通约 4、6、4 秒，初版约 30 秒。
已有浏览器来电、视频、语音和舵机演示材料，以及公开的结构加工附件。
归档记录包含 14 个门铃检查入口和 17 个结构设计测试通过，均为主机侧检查。
scope: WebRTC 与媒体基础来自 Espressif；个人工作为板级移植、感知扩展、交互和系统集成。
可信局域网单浏览器原型，无用户级开门鉴权；空载舵机模拟门锁，没有真实锁体反馈。
4、6、4 秒仅为历史三轮记录，不外推为公网性能或长期可靠性。
归档期未重建固件、烧录或重新实机验收；8 kHz 通话与 16 kHz 提示音混音路径仍有兼容问题。

en.title: ESP32-P4/C5 Multimodal WebRTC Doorbell
en.summary: Embedded audio and video, radar and visual presence sensing connected to browser calls and a servo door-lock demonstration.
en.role: Independent development · Board adaptation and integration on Espressif examples
contributions: Adapted OV5647 video, ES8311 two-way audio and the ESP32-C5 wireless link on the WT99P4C5-S1 board.
Integrated LD2450 radar and visual presence detection with zone checks, event debouncing and repeated-ring suppression.
Connected a PWM servo queue, hold and reset sequence to the Chinese browser interface and call interactions.
Adjusted LAN connection waits and media cleanup, and organized device logs and acrylic manufacturing assets.
results: Historical logs record three LAN call-setup times of about 4, 6 and 4 seconds, compared with about 30 seconds initially.
Existing demonstrations cover browser calls, video, audio and servo motion; structural manufacturing assets are also public.
Archive records show 14 doorbell check entry points and 17 structural-design tests passing, all on the host side.
scope: WebRTC and media foundations come from Espressif. My work covers board adaptation, sensing extensions, interaction and integration.
A trusted-LAN, single-browser prototype without user-level unlock authentication. An unloaded servo simulates the lock without real lock feedback.
The 4, 6 and 4 second observations are three historical trials, not evidence of Internet performance or long-term reliability.
Archiving did not rebuild or flash firmware or repeat device acceptance. The 8 kHz call and 16 kHz prompt-mixing paths retain a compatibility issue.

zh.title: GOAI 双臂策略训练与仿真评测
zh.summary: 围绕多相机视觉语言动作策略，完成接口适配、训练部署、本地闭环评测与失败分析。
zh.role: 个人竞赛项目 · 开源模型适配、实验组织与策略部署
contributions: 适配头部与双腕三路图像、语言指令及 14 维机器人状态和动作接口。
配置动作头微调与后续多任务训练，管理检查点、归一化设置和版本冻结。
联通策略 WebSocket 服务与多环境仿真执行，整理运行恢复和评测护栏。
组织两版完整评测、候选检查点筛选及按任务失败分析，保留可追溯结果与视频索引。
flow: 三路图像与机器人状态
逐任务评测与失败分析
results: 稳定基线为 33/600，20k 微调为 28/600；各覆盖 24 项任务，两版累计 1,200 回合。
后续 Candidate C 的 60k、80k、100k 检查点共做 45 回合筛选，各为 0/15，没有完成完整 600 回合复评。
诊断材料覆盖 29 个代表回合和 87 段三相机视频索引。
scope: StarVLA、QwenOFT、XPolicyLab 与 RoboDojo 为上游基础；个人贡献是适配、配置、集成、运行修复和分析。
以上均为本地仿真记录，没有确认的官方成绩；20k 总体观测值低于基线，不宣称性能提升。
45 回合筛选不能与完整 600 回合直接排名，100k 候选没有已证实的性能优势。
归档期未重跑 GPU 训练或完整仿真；20k 原始回合、完整 ACT 源码及部分历史测试对应实现仍有缺口。

en.title: GOAI Bimanual Policy Training and Evaluation
en.summary: Multicamera vision-language-action policy adaptation, training deployment, local closed-loop simulation and failure analysis.
en.role: Individual competition project · Open-model adaptation, experiment organization and policy deployment
contributions: Adapted head and wrist camera inputs, language instructions, and 14-dimensional robot state and action interfaces.
Configured action-head fine-tuning and later multitask training, managing checkpoints, normalization settings and frozen versions.
Connected a WebSocket policy service to multiple simulation environments and organized recovery checks and evaluation guardrails.
Organized two full evaluations, candidate-checkpoint screening and task-level failure analysis with traceable results and video indices.
results: The stable baseline achieved 33/600 and the 20k fine-tune 28/600 across 24 tasks each: 1,200 episodes in total.
Candidate C checkpoints at 60k, 80k and 100k received 45 screening episodes in total, each scoring 0/15; no full 600-episode reevaluation was completed.
Diagnostic material covers 29 representative episodes and an index of 87 three-camera videos.
scope: StarVLA, QwenOFT, XPolicyLab and RoboDojo provide the upstream foundations. My work is adaptation, configuration, integration, runtime fixes and analysis.
These are local simulation records without a confirmed official score. The 20k aggregate observation is below baseline and does not establish improvement.
The 45-episode screening is not directly rankable against full 600-episode evaluations; no performance advantage is established for the 100k candidate.
Archiving did not rerun GPU training or full simulation. Raw 20k episodes, complete ACT source and implementations for some historical tests remain incomplete.

zh.title: 机械臂轨迹规划与控制仿真
zh.summary: 从平面二自由度扩展到空间三自由度，比较轨迹方法并分析 PID 跟踪与多体仿真。
zh.role: 独立开发 · 运动学建模、轨迹规划与控制仿真
contributions: 建立二自由度平面及三自由度空间机械臂，完成正逆运动学与工作空间分析。
实现三次、五次多项式、梯形速度与笛卡尔直线轨迹，组织统一条件下的规划比较。
实现简化关节动力学的 PID 跟踪，分析末端误差、峰值误差及控制力矩。
搭建 URDF 与 PyBullet 可视化及三自由度重力补偿力矩控制，核对几何坐标一致性。
results: 保留四组轨迹的 MATLAB 图表、CSV 与分析，形成规划到控制的完整仿真链路。
归档期 MATLAB R2022a 平面与空间数值检查通过；两项 Python 源码连接检查通过。
区分二自由度运动学回放与三自由度重力动力学控制，避免混用两种验证结果。
scope: 本人独立完成建模与控制仿真实现；其他成员的报告和汇报工作不归为本人贡献。
全部控制结果为仿真，只控制末端位置；没有实体机械臂、夹爪或物体接触实验。
MATLAB 使用独立关节简化模型；PyBullet 的动力学、参数和控制增益不同，指标不能直接互换。
归档期未重新执行完整 PyBullet 重力仿真；Python 连接检查不是仿真运行验收。

en.title: Robot Trajectory Planning and Control Simulation
en.summary: From a planar 2-DOF arm to a spatial 3-DOF model: comparing trajectories, PID tracking and multibody simulation.
en.role: Independent development · Kinematics, trajectory planning and control simulation
contributions: Modeled planar 2-DOF and spatial 3-DOF arms with forward and inverse kinematics and workspace analysis.
Implemented cubic, quintic, trapezoidal-velocity and Cartesian straight-line trajectories for comparison under shared conditions.
Implemented PID tracking on simplified joint dynamics and analyzed end-effector error, peak error and control torque.
Built URDF and PyBullet visualization and 3-DOF gravity-compensated torque control, checking geometric coordinate alignment.
results: Archived MATLAB plots, CSV files and analysis for four trajectory methods form a complete planning-to-control simulation workflow.
Archive checks passed planar and spatial numerical tests in MATLAB R2022a and two Python source-wiring checks.
The documentation separates 2-DOF kinematic playback from 3-DOF gravity-enabled dynamics control.
scope: I independently developed the modeling and control simulation; other members' reporting and presentation work is not claimed as mine.
All control results are simulated and concern end-effector position. There are no physical-arm, gripper or object-contact experiments.
MATLAB uses simplified independent-joint dynamics. PyBullet uses different dynamics, parameters and gains, so their metrics are not interchangeable.
Archiving did not repeat full PyBullet gravity simulation; Python source-wiring checks are not simulation acceptance.

zh.title: 办公打印配送机器人交互端
zh.summary: 面向打印与配送任务的表单、地图和队列界面，配套 HTTP 演示与 ROS2 桥接接口。
zh.role: 软件原型实践 · 交互端与接口整理，未确认完整团队分工
contributions: 整理 Web/PWA 任务提交、状态展示和取消流程，以及 HTTP/ROS2 数据契约。
保留上传桥接与 USB 打印后端示例，明确桥接可达、任务提交和物理完成的区别。
flow: 队列 / 状态展示与桥接接口
results: 本地 Node HTTP/API 与离线应用逻辑共 4 组检查通过。
形成可本地演示的界面与接口原型。
scope: 缺少任务调度器、Nav2 客户端和底盘控制；未执行 ROS2 构建或真实打印配送。
界面地图为示意；打印后端完成只代表提交或字节发送，不证明出纸、到达或交付。

en.title: Office Print and Delivery Robot Console
en.summary: Forms, a map and a queue for print-and-delivery tasks, with an HTTP demo and ROS2 bridge interfaces.
en.role: Software prototype practice · Interface and contract organization; complete team roles unconfirmed
contributions: Organized Web/PWA submission, status and cancellation flows with HTTP/ROS2 data contracts.
Retained upload-bridge and USB-printer examples while separating API reachability, submission and physical completion.
flow: Submit a file and task parameters
Queue / status display and bridge interfaces
results: Four local Node HTTP/API and offline application-logic check groups passed.
A locally demonstrable interface and API prototype is available.
scope: No scheduler, Nav2 client or chassis controller is included; ROS2 builds and real print delivery were not executed.
The map is illustrative. Printer-backend completion means submission or byte transfer, not paper output, arrival or delivery.

zh.title: 自行车后向视觉与雷达原型
zh.summary: K230 目标检测与 SR111 雷达距离检查的课程团队原型。
zh.role: 团队成员 · 系统架构、集成及雷达与 YOLO 结合研究
contributions: 承担系统架构与集成，研究视觉检测触发雷达检查的应用流程。
按团队边界保留视觉、解析和配置快照，不认领队友的雷达通信或模型训练工作。
flow: 视觉存在门控、雷达距离检查与提示
results: 公开了应用、雷达解析、视觉接口与部署配置。
主机合成探针复现 5 项历史雷达解析问题。
scope: 只是视觉存在门控加距离检查，没有目标关联、时间同步或卡尔曼跟踪。
解析缺陷保留；未重训、上板或路测，不提供道路安全、精度或延迟保证。

en.title: Bicycle Rear Vision and Radar Prototype
en.summary: A team coursework prototype combining K230 object detection with SR111 radar distance checks.
en.role: Team member · System architecture, integration and radar–YOLO combination research
contributions: Worked on system architecture and integration, researching a vision-triggered radar-check workflow.
Archived vision, decoder and configuration snapshots with team boundaries; teammates' radar communication and model training are not claimed as mine.
flow: Visual-presence gating, radar distance checks and alerts
results: Application, radar-decoder, vision-interface and deployment-configuration snapshots are public.
Host-side synthetic probes reproduced five historical radar-decoding issues.
scope: Presence-gated distance checking only, without target association, timestamp synchronization or Kalman tracking.
Decoder defects remain. No new training, board execution or road test supports safety, accuracy or latency guarantees.

zh.title: 核自适应与 Wi-Fi 指纹定位
zh.summary: 集合五类核滤波、历史线性指纹实验，以及 Transformer 室内定位阅读笔记。
zh.role: 课程复现与实现整理 · 算法接口、数值保护及教学说明
contributions: 整理五类核滤波的统一类接口与坐标实验，保留独立的 70/20 和 40/16 两套数据协议。
增加便携 CSV 入口、微型合成检查，并整理 Attention 与 AaT 阅读说明。
flow: 测量特征或 RSSI 指纹
坐标回归与学习曲线分析
results: MATLAB 五类核滤波及 Wi-Fi 组件的微型合成检查通过。
形成算法、数据契约与 Transformer 阅读资料的统一入口。
scope: 实测数据由教师提供并预处理，未公开；归档期没有重跑完整课程实验或硬件采集。
标准算法为教学复现，Transformer 部分为阅读说明；历史曲线不构成跨场景精度或算法排名。

en.title: Kernel Adaptive and Wi-Fi Fingerprint Localization
en.summary: Five kernel filters, historical linear fingerprint experiments and reading notes on Transformers for indoor localization.
en.role: Course reproduction and implementation organization · Interfaces, numerical safeguards and teaching notes
contributions: Organized common interfaces for five kernel filters and coordinate experiments, keeping the 70/20 and 40/16 data protocols separate.
Added a portable CSV entry and micro-synthetic checks, and organized Attention and AaT reading notes.
results: Micro-synthetic MATLAB checks passed for the five kernel filters and the Wi-Fi component.
A shared entry organizes algorithms, data contracts and Transformer reading material.
scope: Measured data were supplied and preprocessed by the teacher and are excluded. Full course experiments and hardware collection were not repeated during archiving.
The algorithms are educational reproductions; the Transformer component is explanatory. Historical curves do not establish cross-site accuracy or algorithm rankings.

zh.title: 手写 RBF-SVR 电池健康估计
zh.summary: 用 NumPy 实现回归训练流程，比较原始与工程特征的跨电池表现。
zh.role: 课程实现与实验分析 · 核回归、特征比较和评估协议
contributions: 实现 RBF 核、SMO 风格 SVR 优化、预测及指标计算。
组织随机划分与留一电池评估，分析相对特征和标称容量的作用。
flow: SVR 训练及跨电池评估
results: 历史宏平均 LOBO R²：原始特征 0.5239，调参工程特征 0.4363，未见整体改善。
归档期完成小规模合成回归与输出检查，未重跑完整实验。
scope: 调参协议不是嵌套 LOBO，且相对特征假定能读取测试电池初始特征。
简化优化器未获最优性认证；数据和预处理来源仍有限制，不主张新 SVR 算法。

en.title: Handwritten RBF-SVR for Battery SOH
en.summary: A NumPy regression workflow comparing original and engineered features across batteries.
en.role: Course implementation and experiment analysis · Kernel regression, features and evaluation protocols
contributions: Implemented an RBF kernel, SMO-style SVR optimization, prediction and metrics.
Organized random-split and leave-one-battery-out evaluations of relative features and nominal capacity.
results: Historical macro-average LOBO R² was 0.5239 for original features and 0.4363 for tuned engineered features, without overall improvement.
Archiving ran small synthetic regression and output checks, without repeating the full experiment.
scope: Parameter selection was not nested LOBO, and relative features assume access to initial test-battery features.
The simplified optimizer has no optimality certification; data and preprocessing provenance remain limited. No new SVR algorithm is claimed.

zh.title: 星座图调制方式识别
zh.summary: 从星座图几何特征到 NumPy 手写 MLP，识别六类数字调制。
zh.role: 课程项目实现 · 特征工程、分类器与实验比较
contributions: 组织离群点过滤、PCA 对齐、尺度归一化及 338 维特征提取。
实现 MLP 前后向、交叉熵与 Adam，并保留 CNN、Softmax 等探索记录。
results: 历史记录为 381/420，即 90.71%；该准确率本轮没有新复现。
120 张合成图的小型训练、参数更新和输出重载检查通过。
scope: 输入为 PNG 星座图，不是原始 IQ；课程数据及权重未公开。
特征选择参考过测试表现，各对照预算不同；不能作为独立盲测或严格算法排名。

en.title: Constellation-Based Modulation Recognition
en.summary: Geometric constellation features and a handwritten NumPy MLP for six digital modulation classes.
en.role: Course project implementation · Features, classifiers and experiment comparisons
contributions: Organized outlier filtering, PCA alignment, scale normalization and 338-dimensional feature extraction.
Implemented MLP forward and backward passes, cross-entropy and Adam, retaining CNN and Softmax explorations.
results: Historical results record 381/420, or 90.71%; this accuracy was not newly reproduced during archiving.
Small training, parameter-update and output-reload checks passed on 120 synthetic images.
scope: Inputs are PNG constellation images, not raw IQ. Course data and weights are excluded.
Feature selection consulted test performance and comparison budgets differ; results are not an independent blind test or controlled algorithm ranking.

zh.title: 视觉与模式识别课程实验
zh.summary: 涵盖三图拼接、统计分类与 CIFAR-10 网络训练的课程合集。
zh.role: 课程实践 · 流程实现、特征实验与结果分析
contributions: 组织 SIFT/FLANN/RANSAC 拼接与羽化融合，以及贝叶斯、密度估计和 SVM 特征实验。
整合 ResNet/VGG 训练入口、层尺寸、分类指标与混淆矩阵输出。
flow: 图像预处理与特征 / 模型
拼接或分类与结果分析
results: 合成纹理三图拼接、小规模统计分类和 LIBSVM 检查通过。
ResNet/VGG 完成随机张量的 CPU 单批训练与梯度检查。
scope: 本轮未重训 CIFAR-10，也未重跑校园照片、课程人脸数据或完整网格搜索。
基础算法与求解器来自 OpenCV、PyTorch 和 LIBSVM；历史选模与缩放协议存在局限。

en.title: Vision and Pattern Recognition Labs
en.summary: Coursework spanning three-image stitching, statistical classification and CIFAR-10 network training.
en.role: Course practice · Pipeline implementation, feature experiments and result analysis
contributions: Organized SIFT/FLANN/RANSAC stitching with feather blending and Bayesian, density-estimation and SVM feature experiments.
Integrated ResNet/VGG training entries, layer dimensions, classification metrics and confusion-matrix outputs.
results: Synthetic-texture stitching and small statistical-classification and LIBSVM checks passed.
ResNet/VGG models completed CPU single-batch training and gradient checks with random tensors.
scope: No new CIFAR-10 training, campus-photo run, course face-data evaluation or full grid search was performed.
Core algorithms and solvers come from OpenCV, PyTorch and LIBSVM; historical model-selection and scaling protocols have limitations.

zh.title: 超级电容储能监控系统
zh.summary: 连接 STM32 采集、蓝牙通信、继电器控制与 FPGA 显示的团队课程项目。
zh.role: 五人课程团队成员 · 具体个人模块分工未确认
contributions: 参与储能监控课程项目；现存资料支持团队成员身份，未据此认领全部系统实现。
公开团队应用逻辑、配置及两个独立 FPGA 快照，保留版本差异。
flow: 电容侧采样与蓝牙链路
控制及 FPGA 并行输入显示
results: 保留 STM32 应用与两个 FPGA RTL/约束快照。
两套 FPGA 快照分别通过 Icarus 编译；未做行为仿真。
scope: 最终配对固件和端到端协议未确认，现存材料不是完整可构建硬件版本。
未构建 MCU、综合 FPGA 或新上板；充电功率、时长和响应数字属于设计要求，非实测成绩。

en.title: Supercapacitor Energy Monitor
en.summary: A team course project connecting STM32 acquisition, Bluetooth, relay control and an FPGA display.
en.role: Member of a five-person course team · Individual module assignments unconfirmed
contributions: Participated in the monitoring project. Available records establish team membership, not sole implementation of the system.
Published selected team application logic, configuration and two separate FPGA snapshots with their differences retained.
results: STM32 application files and two FPGA RTL/constraint snapshots are retained.
Both FPGA snapshots compiled separately with Icarus; behavioral simulation was not performed.
scope: Final paired firmware and the end-to-end protocol are unconfirmed; the archive is not a complete buildable hardware release.
No MCU build, FPGA synthesis or new board test was performed. Power, duration and response figures are design requirements, not measurements.

zh.title: CC1352 无线传感器节点设计
zh.summary: 以可读网表和器件连接导出保存团队物联网硬件设计。
zh.role: 团队课程项目 · 个人逐项分工尚未确认
contributions: 以团队成果边界整理主控、电源、射频和扩展接口的设计导出。
对照 PST、XML 与器件表，提供可运行的连接一致性检查。
flow: 网络连接与多格式一致性核对
results: 公开设计包含 55 个器件、62 个电气网络和 220 个已连接引脚。
主机结构核对及篡改负例检测通过。
scope: 未恢复可编译固件；原生 CAD 保持私有，历史 DRC 有 2 个错误和 1 项跳过检查。
主机一致性检查不是当前 ERC/DRC、射频、电气或板级验收。

en.title: CC1352 Wireless Sensor Node Design
en.summary: A team IoT hardware design preserved through readable netlists and component-connection exports.
en.role: Team coursework · Individual task assignments unconfirmed
contributions: Organized controller, power, RF and expansion-interface exports as team design material.
Cross-checked PST, XML and component tables with an executable connection-consistency check.
results: The public design contains 55 components, 62 electrical nets and 220 connected pins.
Host structure checks and a tampered-connection negative test passed.
scope: Buildable firmware was not recovered and native CAD remains private. Historical DRC records two errors and one skipped check.
Host consistency checks are not current ERC/DRC, RF, electrical or board acceptance.

zh.title: FPGA 棋钟与密码锁
zh.summary: 用历史 RTL、状态控制和有限行为测试理解数字系统的版本与接口。
zh.role: 课程练习与小组材料 · 不主张全部 RTL 独立原创
contributions: 整理双人计时、键盘、显示及密码控制的多版本源码和约束。
增加独立版本编译、控制器短仿真与已知缺陷复现，保留原始 RTL。
flow: 计时 / 密码逻辑及显示报警
results: 完成版本级 Icarus 编译核对与有限计时、控制器行为检查。
二进制密码版本覆盖 128 种输入；原样编译失败和 X 启动等问题明确保留。
scope: 部分测试绕过键盘扫描并初始化内部寄存器；主棋钟需临时兼容副本，不能称全系统通过。
没有完整键盘显示链、Vivado 时序收敛或板级验收，原始引脚约束仍需核对。

en.title: FPGA Chess Clock and Password Lock
en.summary: Historical RTL, state control and limited behavior tests for understanding digital-system versions and interfaces.
en.role: Course exercises and group material · No sole-authorship claim for all RTL
contributions: Organized multiple source and constraint versions for two-player timing, keypads, displays and password control.
Added separate-version compilation, short controller simulations and defect reproduction while preserving original RTL.
flow: Timing / password logic, display and alarms
results: Version-level Icarus compilation checks and limited timing and controller behavior checks were completed.
The binary password version covers 128 input combinations; original compile failures and unknown-state startup defects remain explicit.
scope: Some tests bypass keypad scanning and initialize internal registers. The main chess-clock version needs a temporary compatibility copy; this is not full-system acceptance.
No complete keypad/display chain, Vivado timing closure or board acceptance is established; original pin constraints still need review.

zh.title: 麦克纳姆轮电磁循迹小车
zh.summary: 从 PWM 运动控制到电磁采样与 PD 调参的早期团队机器人实践。
zh.role: 团队成员 · 共同承担任务三、参数调节、代码完善与报告
contributions: 共同负责 PWM 电机驱动与麦克纳姆轮运动控制。
参与参数调节、代码完善及报告；采样与完整循迹算法保留团队归属。
flow: PD 转向与四轮运动控制
results: 保留三个原始应用源码文件和接口说明。
主机 API stub 检查通过 285 个断言，并复现超出校准上限时的循环问题。
scope: 主机测试没有运行固件 main 或输出真实 PWM，未重建完整固件或上车。
历史比赛和调试叙述未逐项对应当前快照，不作为本轮性能实测。

en.title: Mecanum Electromagnetic Line-Following Robot
en.summary: An early team robotics project spanning PWM motion control, electromagnetic sensing and PD tuning.
en.role: Team member · Shared task three, tuning, code refinement and reporting
contributions: Shared responsibility for PWM motor driving and Mecanum-wheel motion control.
Worked on parameter tuning, code refinement and reporting; sensing and the full line-following algorithm remain team work.
results: Three original application source files and interface notes are retained.
Host API-stub checks passed 285 assertions and reproduced a loop defect above the calibration limit.
scope: Host tests did not run firmware main or output real PWM; no complete firmware rebuild or vehicle test was performed.
Historical competition and tuning accounts are not mapped item by item to this snapshot and are not new performance measurements.

zh.title: 控制系统与 PLC 实验
zh.summary: 从状态反馈、观测器与数字控制模型，到交通灯 STATE3 梯形图的课程合集。
zh.role: 课程实验；PLC 团队中负责 STATE3 设计与调试
contributions: 整理状态反馈、观测器、数字 PID 和最少拍控制的脚本与模型。
保留本人负责的东西直行 STATE3 八级梯形图与 I/O 核对，完整状态机属于团队。
flow: 控制对象 / 阶段输入
反馈仿真或梯形图阶段输出
results: MATLAB 数值核对通过，三个原 Simulink 模型各执行到 0.6 秒。
STATE3 图像、转录与定时参数的归档一致性检查通过。
scope: 短仿真不是完整调节、无纹波或鲁棒性验收；历史模型系数问题保留。
没有原生 PLC 工程或新编译、下载及实机测试；STATE3 不证明完整互锁、黄灯或安全停止。

en.title: Control Systems and PLC Labs
en.summary: Coursework from state feedback, observers and digital-control models to a traffic-light STATE3 ladder module.
en.role: Course experiments; STATE3 design and debugging within the PLC team
contributions: Organized state-feedback, observer, digital-PID and deadbeat-control scripts and models.
Retained my east–west-through STATE3 module as eight ladder rungs with I/O checks; the complete state machine belongs to the team.
results: MATLAB numerical checks passed and three original Simulink models each ran to 0.6 seconds.
STATE3 image, transcription and timer-parameter archive-consistency checks passed.
scope: Short simulations do not establish full settling behavior, ripple-free response or robustness; historical coefficient issues remain.
No native PLC project or new compilation, download or device test is available. STATE3 does not establish complete interlocks, yellow lights or safe stopping.

zh.title: 模拟调制与隔离驱动电路
zh.summary: 保存通信调制电路与文献驱动结构的历史搭建、参数和波形观察。
zh.role: 模拟通信团队队长；隔离驱动项目负责仿真与报告
contributions: 参与文氏桥、MC1496 调制与滤波团队设计；逐模块个人分工未确认。
在隔离驱动课程项目中依据文献搭建近似 Multisim 电路，完成仿真与报告。
results: 公开原始电路截图、参数表和历史波形记录。
参数、图像与文件一致性检查通过；未重新求解电路。
scope: 原生工程未公开，本轮未运行 Multisim 或硬件；历史截图不证明 SSB 抑制度或绝缘性能。
驱动截图未证实使用 SiC 模型，脉冲标称仅 10 Hz；不能报告高频性能或同步延时。

en.title: Analog Modulation and Isolated Gate-Drive Circuits
en.summary: Historical circuit construction, parameters and waveform observations for communication modulation and literature-based gate driving.
en.role: Analog-communication team leader; simulation and reporting for the isolated-drive project
contributions: Participated in the team's Wien-bridge, MC1496 modulation and filter design; individual module assignments are unconfirmed.
Built an approximate literature-based Multisim circuit and handled simulation and reporting for the isolated-drive coursework.
results: Original circuit screenshots, parameter tables and historical waveform records are public.
Parameter, image and file-consistency checks passed without newly solving the circuits.
scope: Native projects are excluded and no new Multisim or hardware run was performed; screenshots do not establish SSB suppression or insulation performance.
The drive screenshots do not confirm a SiC model and specify only a nominal 10 Hz pulse; high-frequency performance and synchronization delays are unsupported.

zh.title: C 单链表图书借阅管理
zh.summary: 用结构体、动态内存和链表操作实现内存中的图书与借阅状态管理。
zh.role: 两人课程设计中负责单链表实现
contributions: 实现浏览、头插新增、按索引删除及借阅状态查询与修改。
保留原始源码，补充脚本化功能检查和隔离缺陷复现。
flow: 链表操作与借阅状态输出
results: 原字节源码通过 GCC 编译，7 个功能场景运行通过。
实际复现 8 项历史错误行为，明确区分正常功能与缺陷证据。
scope: 记录只存在内存中，不含持久化、认证或真实借阅业务。
非正索引、EOF、非数字和超长输入仍有缺陷；历史实现未作为生产系统修复。

en.title: C Linked-List Library Management
en.summary: In-memory book and loan-status management using structures, dynamic memory and linked-list operations.
en.role: Responsible for the linked-list implementation in a two-person course project
contributions: Implemented browsing, head insertion, indexed deletion, and loan-status queries and updates.
Preserved original source and added scripted functional checks and isolated defect reproduction.
results: Byte-preserved source compiled with GCC and passed seven executed functional scenarios.
Eight historical error behaviors were reproduced, separately from successful functionality.
scope: Records are memory-only, without persistence, authentication or real lending operations.
Nonpositive indices, EOF, nonnumeric and overlong inputs retain defects; this historical implementation has not been repaired as a production system.
